reward_amount_above_min.meaning: the creator-chosen reward amount is just above the minimum-per-epoch threshold

fees_reduce_delivered_amount.meaning: protocol fees applied during campaign creation reduce the tokens delivered to the Distributor
fees_reduce_delivered_amount.checkpoint: during campaign creation, after fee deduction

real_per_epoch_distribution_below_min.meaning: the real per-epoch distribution actually delivered to the Distributor is below the minimum reward-per-epoch threshold
real_per_epoch_distribution_below_min.checkpoint: after campaign creation, post-fee delivered amount

assumptions: The minimum reward-per-epoch invariant is checked during campaign creation in _createCampaign().
The Distributor is the recipient of the post-fee distributed amount.
The creator is permissionless; no specific authorization state is required.

unresolved.description: Exact fee rate and minimum reward-per-epoch threshold values are not given, so the numeric bound cannot be encoded; the below-minimum relation is kept as a grounded Boolean.
No explicit action fragment describes the campaign creation call; the trigger is only implied by the PoC steps.

limitations: The below-minimum relation is represented as a Boolean because the report omits the numeric fee rate and minimum threshold.
Only the inadequate_per_epoch_incentives impact is formalized; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
The pre-fee versus post-fee comparison is not numerically expressible from the report.
